new_text: As from 1 September 2032, Contracting Parties shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the preceding series of amendments.
note: Transitional provision; builder skips these. Old 16.2/16.3 yielded no requirements, so nothing removed/modified.

new_text: As from 1 September 2029, Contracting Parties shall not be obliged to accept type approvals to the preceding series for systems capable of withholding HOR's on highway-like roads.
note: Transitional; slight chance because of technical HOR reference.

new_text: Contracting Parties may grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments.
Contracting Parties shall continue to grant extensions of existing approvals to any preceding series of amendments.
DCAS shall only be permitted to operate when a driver is in control.
note: Explanatory/informational intro text (like Para 2, which did yield a requirement). Builder may keep one normative-sounding sentence; this is the likeliest.

new_text: Vehicles without the ability to be controlled by a driver (Categories X and Y) shall not be required to comply with this Regulation.
note: Scope exemption inside informational note; more likely captured under Scope para 1.

new_text: For vehicles with ADS other than Categories X and Y, no special provisions or exemptions shall apply in the manual driving mode.
